$comment: Which source documents become portal documents, and where each one lands.
Metadata only — no policy text lives here, so this file is safe in a public
repo. The .docx sources are NOT in the repo and must not be: put them in a
local folder and point PORTAL_SOURCE_DIR at it.
tier 1 — versioned, referenced by the offline contract
tier 2 — mountain standards, everyone who teaches
tier 3 — employer policies, employed office staff only (never an instructor)
Only documents cleared in the audit appear here. Third-party copyright,
board material and anything still marked 'decide' is deliberately absent.
